   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 28, 2026 - Aug 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Davey Lumen_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "It’s frustrating when a good app like this has so many ads. Also, I can’t restart the chats. The ads are sometimes suggestive and freeze my screen afterward. The bot sometimes glitches out and speaks gibberish. I’m honestly starting to doubt if every five-star review on this app is even real. Quick thing—the app sometimes kicks me out, and I have to rejoin a few times to stop it. Maybe it’s my iPad, but honestly, it wouldn’t affect how I feel."
            2. _A_Miller13_, Aug 3, 2026, 4/5: "The ads do get in the way. Up until now I was okay with the ads. Recently, I would try to get on a character, and an ad would pop up. Normally this wasn’t a problem, but it has been making the app freeze, forcing me to leave the app and lose the character. That is my only complaint though. This app is amazing all around though!"
            3. _pinki_k_, Jul 14, 2026, 4/5: "This app is really good!! Way better then any other ive used my only problem is on some chats it freezes I’m not sure if anyone else has this issue or if it’s just me apart from that it’s amazing!"
